title: Launch World Bank Data Shiny App — worldbank
text: function: Loads required datasets: mfi, country_code, mfi_population. Builds mfi_cor fly selected indicators mfi. Sets formatting options numbers fonts. Defines helper function format_bignum human-readable large numbers (e.g., K, M, Bn, Tn). Launches Shiny app using shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server). Shiny app interface includes: Country Comparison Compare selected indicator across countries. Indicator Comparison Compare multiple indicators one country. Population Pyramid Visualize male/female population distribution. Barplot Rank countries selected indicator. Scatterplot Show relationship two indicators. Map Animated choropleth map year. Index Tabular view dataset.
